title: 浮動式道床減振
summary: 浮動式道床減振以「浮動道床隔振共振及附加質量效應」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。浮動式道床利用彈性支承把軌道質量與基礎分開，低頻共振與高頻隔振同時存在；隔振效果必須指定輸入位置、輸出位置與頻率範圍。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops floating-slab isolation resonance and added-mass effects through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Floating slabs separate track mass from the foundation through resilient supports, creating both low-frequency resonance and high-frequency isolation; performance needs specified input and output positions and frequency range. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 隔振固有頻率與靜載壓縮量
stages.titleEn: Isolation natural frequency & Static support compression
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「隔振固有頻率」與「靜載壓縮量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Isolation natural frequency" and "Static support compression": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 隔振固有頻率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Isolation natural frequency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「隔振固有頻率」如何影響浮動式道床減振的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Isolation natural frequency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Floating-slab track vibration isolation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 固有頻率由剛度質量比的平方根決定。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.33846 Hz。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。線性單自由度且基礎固定；計算無阻尼固有頻率。使用自由衰減頻率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；支承硬化會提高固有頻率，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隔振固有頻率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Natural frequency follows the square root of stiffness-to-mass ratio. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.33846 Hz. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Linear single-degree system with a fixed base; the calculated frequency is undamped. Use free-decay frequency as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Support hardening raises natural frequency; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Isolation natural frequency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg; y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承硬化會提高固有頻率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support hardening raises natural frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隔振固有頻率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Isolation natural frequency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隔振固有頻率
knowledge.text: 固有頻率由剛度質量比的平方根決定。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.33846 Hz。
knowledge.textEn: Natural frequency follows the square root of stiffness-to-mass ratio. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承硬化會提高固有頻率 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support hardening raises natural frequency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「隔振固有頻率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Isolation natural frequency" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承硬化會提高固有頻率
固有頻率由剛度質量比的平方根決定。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承到底會使線性隔振失效
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support hardening raises natural frequency.
Natural frequency follows the square root of stiffness-to-mass ratio.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Bottoming out invalidates linear isolation.
quiz.explanation: 固有頻率由剛度質量比的平方根決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Natural frequency follows the square root of stiffness-to-mass ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 隔振固有頻率：定量估算
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隔振固有頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Isolation natural frequency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=3.33846 Hz。模型邊界：線性單自由度且基礎固定；計算無阻尼固有頻率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg; y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz. Increasing only k with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.33846 Hz. Boundary: Linear single-degree system with a fixed base; the calculated frequency is undamped; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以自由衰減頻率區分模型與觀察，先用模型質量、靜剛度與經阻尼修正的自由衰減頻率建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use free-decay frequency to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=3.33846 Hz。模型邊界：線性單自由度且基礎固定；計算無阻尼固有頻率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Linear single-degree system with a fixed base; the calculated frequency is undamped; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「隔振固有頻率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Isolation natural frequency", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只看峰值幅度會漏掉共振移動
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：重心偏移使單支承過載
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz。

This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A shifted centre of mass overloads individual supports.
Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg; y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg; y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 隔振固有頻率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Isolation natural frequency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隔振固有頻率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Isolation natural frequency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以自由衰減頻率區分模型與觀察，先用模型質量、靜剛度與經阻尼修正的自由衰減頻率建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「隔振固有頻率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use free-decay frequency to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model mass, static stiffness and damping-corrected free-decay frequency, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Isolation natural frequency. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「隔振固有頻率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出線性單自由度且基礎固定；計算無阻尼固有頻率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由支承硬化會提高固有頻率造成偏離的合成觀察，以自由衰減頻率說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Isolation natural frequency, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Linear single-degree system with a fixed base; the calculated frequency is undamped. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Support hardening raises natural frequency. Explain which evidence in free-decay frequency distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承硬化會提高固有頻率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Support hardening raises natural frequency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以自由衰減頻率區分模型與觀察，先用模型質量、靜剛度與經阻尼修正的自由衰減頻率建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「隔振固有頻率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。

Establish a baseline using model mass, static stiffness and damping-corrected free-decay frequency, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Isolation natural frequency. quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Isolation natural frequency"?

steps.title: 隔振固有頻率：失效診斷
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隔振固有頻率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Isolation natural frequency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支承硬化會提高固有頻率。這個失效與「隔振固有頻率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查自由衰減頻率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Support hardening raises natural frequency. This failure and a measurement bias in Isolation natural frequency can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check free-decay frequency rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用自由衰減頻率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；支承硬化會提高固有頻率，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Support hardening raises natural frequency; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承硬化會提高固有頻率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support hardening raises natural frequency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 支承硬化會提高固有頻率。這個失效與「隔振固有頻率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查自由衰減頻率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。

Cross-check free-decay frequency rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 靜載壓縮量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Static support compression: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「靜載壓縮量」如何影響浮動式道床減振的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Static support compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Floating-slab track vibration isolation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 靜壓縮提供剛度量級檢查，但不能直接證明動態隔振。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 26.9775 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。重力載荷平均且支承線性；不含動載與限位接觸。使用靜態高度與總載重作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；支承到底會使線性隔振失效，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「靜載壓縮量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Static compression checks stiffness scale but does not establish dynamic isolation. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 26.9775 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Gravity load is steady and support linear; dynamic load and travel-stop contact are excluded. Use static height and total load as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Bottoming out invalidates linear isolation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Static support compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=10000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, k=4000000 N/m；y=m*g/k*1000=24.525 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=10000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, k=4000000 N/m; y=m*g/k*1000=24.525 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承到底會使線性隔振失效」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Bottoming out invalidates linear isolation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「靜載壓縮量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Static support compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 靜載壓縮量：定量估算
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「靜載壓縮量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Static support compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=10000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, k=4000000 N/m；y=m*g/k*1000=24.525 mm。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=26.9775 mm。模型邊界：重力載荷平均且支承線性；不含動載與限位接觸；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=10000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, k=4000000 N/m; y=m*g/k*1000=24.525 mm. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.9775 mm. Boundary: Gravity load is steady and support linear; dynamic load and travel-stop contact are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以靜態高度與總載重區分模型與觀察，先用模型總重、各支承高度及靜態載入卸載建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use static height and total load to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 靜載壓縮量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Static support compression: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「靜載壓縮量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Static support compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以靜態高度與總載重區分模型與觀察，先用模型總重、各支承高度及靜態載入卸載建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「靜載壓縮量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use static height and total load to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model total weight, individual support heights and static loading-unloading, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Static support compression. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「靜載壓縮量」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出重力載荷平均且支承線性；不含動載與限位接觸如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由支承到底會使線性隔振失效造成偏離的合成觀察，以靜態高度與總載重說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Static support compression, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Gravity load is steady and support linear; dynamic load and travel-stop contact are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Bottoming out invalidates linear isolation. Explain which evidence in static height and total load distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承到底會使線性隔振失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Bottoming out invalidates linear isolation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 靜載壓縮量：失效診斷
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「靜載壓縮量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Static support compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支承到底會使線性隔振失效。這個失效與「靜載壓縮量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查靜態高度與總載重，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Bottoming out invalidates linear isolation. This failure and a measurement bias in Static support compression can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check static height and total load rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用靜態高度與總載重作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；支承到底會使線性隔振失效，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bottoming out invalidates linear isolation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承到底會使線性隔振失效」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Bottoming out invalidates linear isolation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
